name: Isekai Mom Stories
source:
Incarnate in extreme worlds and live the chaos accompanied by loving mothers who are ready to do anything for their son.

You are shipwrecked on a deserted island and you must survive, fortunately by your side is your mother, the problem is not only to survive, but also that your imagination does not help you anymore to do your wank...

A meteorite will destroy the earth in a month, so your mother locks you in so that no one enters or leaves the house, the problem is that, thanks to that you will possibly die a virgin....

Or worse, a mother who is jealous, cold and calculating, loving and sexy, shameless and horny?

Do you think you can survive these scenarios?

Find out in this kinetic visual novel that will make you think that sometimes a little twist in your circumstances can lead to fantastic moments.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541280/Isekai_Mom_Stories/]Steam[/url]]
